stopped.sentence: Swampwalk (This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Swamp.)
stopped.needs: Swampwalk is not a built landwalk: keywords/combat.mjs LANDWALKS and the evasion list hold only Forestwalk and Islandwalk (plus Nonbasic Landwalk); add Swampwalk -> "Swamp" there (CR 702.14).

stopped.sentence: Mountainwalk (This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Mountain.)
stopped.needs: Mountainwalk keyword: keywords/combat.mjs LANDWALKS has only Forestwalk and Islandwalk (CR 702.14c); add Mountainwalk: "Mountain" there, to KEYWORD_FAMILIES.evasion and vocabulary.mjs

stopped.sentence: Horsemanship (This creature can't be blocked except by creatures with horsemanship.)
stopped.needs: The horsemanship keyword (CR 702.31): not in vocabulary.mjs KEYWORDS, and no blocking rule for it in keywords/combat.mjs (canBlockAttacker's evasion list).

stopped.sentence: Wither (This deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters.)
stopped.needs: Wither keyword (CR 702.80): damage to a creature from a source with wither becomes -1/-1 counters; script/effects/resources.mjs dealDamage and rules/combat.mjs handle only Infect (`infects`), nothing reads Wither

stopped.sentence: Unleash (You may have this creature enter with a +1/+1 counter on it. It can't block as long as it has a +1/+1 counter on it.)
stopped.needs: An unleash keyword: an optional enters-with-a-+1/+1-counter question (riot's ask in rules/entering.mjs without the haste branch; entersWithCounters has no "you may") plus a can't-block static conditioned on the creature having a +1/+1 counter (CR 702.98).

stopped.sentence: Myriad (Whenever this creature attacks, for each opponent other than defending player, you may create a token copy that's tapped and attacking that player or a planeswalker they control. Exile the tokens at end of combat.)
stopped.needs: The myriad keyword (CR 702.116): an attack trigger creating, for each other opponent, a tapped-and-attacking token copy aimed at that player or their planeswalker, exiled at end of combat. Nothing in cards/index.mjs or the vocabulary builds it.

stopped.sentence: This land enters tapped unless a player has 13 or less life.
stopped.needs: a player-life clause in an enters replacement's `unless`: rules/replacement.mjs unlessHolds reads only controls/opponents/opponentsControl, and `condition` is skipped for a self arrival (holder null); needs e.g. unless {players: {lifeAtMost: 13}} or a condition evaluated for who:self

stopped.sentence: This land doesn't untap during your next untap step.
stopped.needs: An effect primitive 'this permanent doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step' usable after addMana in a mana ability (only the exert COST atom sets object.exerted, rules/actions.mjs). And since the sentence follows a different '{T}: Add {X} or {Y}.' on each land, the compiler would also have to attach a learned sentence to the preceding mana ability; as one combined ability it would teach only lands with the same color pair.

stopped.sentence: This creature can block an additional creature each combat.
stopped.needs: a static letting a creature block more than one attacker (CR 509.1a): rules/combat.mjs blockers.check refuses any creature picked twice, and damage assignment for one blocker of several attackers is unbuilt

stopped.sentence: This creature can't attack unless defending player controls an Island.
stopped.needs: A cant-attack `unless` condition about the defending player: rules/statics.mjs cantAttack evaluates `unless` with only the holder's controller in context (no defender), and no condition names "defending player controls" (CR 508.1c).

stopped.sentence: {T}: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to any target this turn.
stopped.needs: A prevention shield of N damage that depletes (CR 615.7): effectUntil prevent-damage's `next` shield prevents ALL of the next damage (rules/replacement.mjs shieldAbility, change.prevent: true), with no amount, and none for a targeted player or creature 'any target'.

stopped.sentence: Banding (Any creatures with banding, and up to one without, can attack in a band. Bands are blocked as a group. If any creatures with banding you control are blocking or being blocked by a creature, you divide that creature's combat damage, not its controller, among any of the creatures it's being blocked by or is blocking.)
stopped.needs: Banding keyword (CR 702.22): attacking in bands, blocking of a band as a group, and the banding player's division of combat damage; nothing in the engine

stopped.sentence: Renown 1 (When this creature deals combat damage to a player, if it isn't renowned, put a +1/+1 counter on it and it becomes renowned.)
stopped.needs: Renown keyword (CR 702.112) and the renowned designation (a condition `renowned: false` and an effect making it renowned); neither exists in keywords/designations.mjs, cards/index.mjs or script/condition.mjs

stopped.sentence: Enlist (As this creature attacks, you may tap a nonattacking creature you control without summoning sickness. When you do, add its power to this creature's until end of turn.)
stopped.needs: An enlist keyword: an optional cost chosen as attackers are declared (tap a nonattacking, non-summoning-sick creature) and the reflexive trigger adding its power (CR 702.154); nothing in rules/combat.mjs offers an "as this creature attacks" choice.

stopped.sentence: This creature can't attack or block alone.
stopped.needs: a static restriction on the whole declaration (CR 506.5, 508.1c, 509.1b): rules/combat.mjs checks no 'can't attack/block alone' rule for the attackers or blockers declared

stopped.sentence: Retrace (You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding a land card in addition to paying its other costs.)
stopped.needs: A card's own retrace (CR 702.81a): rule 'cast-self-from' (rules/actions.mjs playableElsewhere) carries no additionalCost, and 'play-from' statics with additionalCost (Six) are read only from permanents on the battlefield (allPlayPermissions). Needs a retrace keyword or cast-self-from with an additionalCost (discard a land card).

stopped.sentence: You may have this creature assign its combat damage as though it weren't blocked.
stopped.needs: A static rule letting a blocked attacker assign its combat damage to the player or planeswalker it attacks (CR 510.1c-d option); rules/combat.mjs and rules/statics.mjs have none.

stopped.sentence: Intimidate (This creature can't be blocked except by artifact creatures and/or creatures that share a color with it.)
stopped.needs: The intimidate keyword (CR 702.13) in keywords/combat.mjs; a cant-be-blocked-by static cannot stand in, as the selector grammar has no negated sharesColor (only sharesColor: 'self').

stopped.sentence: Buyback {3} (You may pay an additional {3} as you cast this spell. If you do, put this card into your hand as it resolves.)
stopped.needs: A buyback keyword: an optional additional cost and the resolved spell going to its owner's hand instead of the graveyard (CR 702.27); no buyback anywhere in game/engine.

stopped.sentence: Activate only during your turn, before attackers are declared.
stopped.needs: an activation condition for 'during your turn, before the declare attackers step' (CR 602.5b): script/condition.mjs has yourTurn and yourMainPhase but nothing that is true in the beginning phase, precombat main and beginning of combat and false after attackers are declared

stopped.sentence: Learn. (You may reveal a Lesson card you own from outside the game and put it into your hand, or discard a card to draw a card.)
stopped.needs: A learn effect primitive (CR 701.48): fetching a Lesson from outside the game (CR 400.11b, no sideboard model; the same gap that stopped Cunning Wish) or the discard-to-draw alternative. Nothing in game/engine mentions learn.

stopped.sentence: All creatures able to block this creature do so.
stopped.needs: A Lure block requirement: every creature able to block this attacker must (CR 509.1c). rules/combat.mjs blockRequirements has only "must-be-blocked" (at least one blocker), not a per-blocker requirement.

stopped.sentence: Phasing (This phases in or out before you untap during each of your untap steps. While it's phased out, it's treated as though it doesn't exist.)
stopped.needs: The phasing keyword (CR 702.26): the untap step only phases permanents IN (rules/turn.mjs untap, phaseIn); nothing phases out a permanent that has phasing.

stopped.sentence: Provoke (Whenever this creature attacks, you may have target creature defending player controls untap and block it if able.)
stopped.needs: A blocking requirement on a named blocker for a named attacker (CR 702.39a, 509.1c: 'target creature blocks this creature this turn if able'). The engine has only 'must-be-blocked' on the attacker (Vinebred Brawler); no provoke keyword.

stopped.sentence: Jump-start (You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding a card in addition to paying its other costs. Then exile this card.)
stopped.needs: A jump-start keyword (CR 702.133a): cast from the graveyard for its mana cost plus a discard (not an alternative cost), then exiled. flashbackCost (rules/actions.mjs) needs a literal cost on the card's own static, and modeling it as flashback would bake one card's mana cost into the template.

stopped.sentence: When this creature enters, open an Attraction. (Put the top card of your Attraction deck onto the battlefield.)
stopped.needs: Attractions: an Attraction deck, opening an Attraction, and visiting (Unfinity rules). Nothing in game/engine mentions Attractions.

stopped.sentence: Whenever this creature deals damage, you gain that much life.
stopped.needs: A trigger 'this deals damage' to any recipient (player, creature or planeswalker), once per damage event with its total: cards/index.mjs damageDealt only builds to: player/opponent/you (GameEventPlayerDamaged) or damage dealt TO self/creature/enchanted.

stopped.sentence: Creatures without flying can't block this turn.
stopped.needs: nonKeywords in the layers' affects matcher (rules/layers.mjs affects(), read by ruleChanged via staticAffects): a live rule-changing effectUntil over 'creatures without flying' silently ignores nonKeywords (Falter's draft let no creature block, a flier included). The fixed-at-resolution selector form would miss creatures that arrive later (CR 611.2c applies only to characteristics). Falter's two files were deleted.

stopped.sentence: You may pay {1} and return a basic land you control to its owner's hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
stopped.needs: cards/index.mjs (alternative-cost validation, ~line 2021) refuses a printed alternative cost with a returnToHand atom ("nothing pays yet") though rules/actions.mjs alternativeCosts already pays it for sneak; allow returnToHand with a selector there. Fieldmist Borderpost was written and its files removed.

stopped.sentence: {0}: The next 1 damage that would be dealt to this creature this turn is dealt to target creature you control instead.
stopped.needs: A redirection shield effect: "the next N damage that would be dealt to X this turn is dealt to target creature instead" (CR 614.9, 615-style used-up shield). rules/replacement.mjs redirects only "enchanted" (Pariah) statics; no effectUntil redirect with an amount.
